```sql
SELECT o.region, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND o.order_date_local = '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY o.region
```

```sql
SELECT o.region, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date_local >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date_local < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY o.region
```

```sql
SELECT o.region, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.order_date_local >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND o.order_date_local < DATE '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY o.region
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE order_date_local >= '2026-05-01' AND order_date_local < '2026-06-01'
```

```sql
SELECT 
    p.category,
    SUM(ol.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM 
    analytics.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_orders f ON ol.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON f.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND f.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    p.category
ORDER BY 
    units_sold DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers_with_orders
FROM analytics.dim_customers AS c
JOIN analytics.fct_orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date_local >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date_local < '2026-01-01'
```

```sql
SELECT d.country, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND d.calendar_year = 2025
GROUP BY d.country
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(r.amount_eur) AS refunded_euros
FROM analytics.fct_refunds AS r
JOIN analytics.fct_orders AS o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date_local >= '2026-03-01' AND o.order_date_local < '2026-04-01'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
```
